summary.description: Endosulphan is a brown crystalline insecticide and acaricide made of alpha and beta isomers, with a slight odour. It is persistent in the environment and may disrupt endocrine systems.
emission_sources: Agricultural use as an insecticide and acaricide
environmental_impact: Toxic to wildlife, especially fish, and accumulates in organisms
May affect multiple human organs and systems through long-term exposure
Highly persistent in soil and may evaporate into the atmosphere

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Endosulphan poses risks to human health through long-term exposure, potentially affecting various organs and systems, and may act as an endocrine disruptor.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Its persistence and toxic effects call for more sustainable pest control practices and stricter management of chemical substances.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG15_Life_on_Land: Endosulphan is harmful to terrestrial wildlife and accumulates in the environment, threatening biodiversity and soil ecosystems.
